inputs.name: bind
inputs.description: Addresses Valkey listens on, such as ["0.0.0.0"] or ["127.0.0.1", "10.0.0.5"]. A leading - lets Valkey start when that address isn't there. Changing it restarts Valkey.

inputs.name: port
inputs.description: TCP port Valkey listens on. Changing it restarts Valkey.

inputs.name: password
inputs.description: Password every client must give with AUTH, set as requirepass for the default user. Pass it at run time with -var or TF_VAR_password; it never reaches state or the plan.

inputs.name: maxmemory
inputs.description: Memory Valkey may use for data before maxmemory_policy applies, such as "256mb" or "2gb". "0" means no limit.

inputs.name: maxmemory_policy
inputs.description: What Valkey does at maxmemory: noeviction refuses writes; allkeys-lru and the others evict keys, which suits a cache.

inputs.name: rdb
inputs.description: Save RDB snapshots to /var/lib/valkey/dump.rdb, on Valkey's default save points and on shutdown, so data survives a restart.

inputs.name: aof
inputs.description: Log every write to the append-only file in /var/lib/valkey, fsynced once a second, so at most a second of writes is lost in a crash.
